entries.title: Ville de Gland — Contrôle des habitants
entries.covers: Gland residents registry: official entry point for arrival and departure

claims.text: Gland directs arriving and departing residents to its residents registry.
claims.fr: Gland oriente les personnes qui arrivent ou partent vers son Contrôle des habitants.
claims.applicability: Arriving in or departing from Gland. Documents for certificates elsewhere on the page are not arrival requirements.
